versionFinding.meaning: Rhino5 Point4d setters treat XYZ as Euclidean with weight; Rhino6 treats coordinates as homogeneous. Modern docs alone must not select old cap math.
versionFinding.scope: Metadata/read-only official evidence; cap execution and every installer target binding are not proven by this alone.

review.correctness: Independent homogeneous de Boor tensor evaluation covers1445 points, orientation/rational/nonuniform/nonclamped/apex behavior. Requested surface construction is separate from source dome interpretation.
review.ownership: Definition input arrays copied; native handles use existing parent leases and guarded output transaction.
review.security: Kernel/recovery read-only; no original binaries/scripts/accounts executed; all local work/cache D:.
review.limitations: Periodic/discontinuous knot representations, plane fitting/orientation, native curve definition export, exact recovered rail-revolve/dome and actual cap/join graph behavior remain required.

scope: Native tensor-surface import prerequisite only; no full source cap/PC/physical parity and no acceptance row closed.
